text: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.
meaning: Jesus teaches that people who actively make peace reflect God's character. They resolve conflicts and treat others with kindness.

text: Don't be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind.
meaning: Paul encourages Christians to change their thinking instead of blindly following society. Spiritual transformation begins within.

text: I am the vine. You are the branches.
meaning: Jesus explains that spiritual growth depends on maintaining a relationship with him.

text: Casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
meaning: Peter encourages believers to bring their worries to God, trusting in his care.

text: Let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger.
meaning: James teaches the importance of listening carefully and controlling our reactions.
